company.name: McKleron Global Partners
company.description: Founded in 2015, McKleron Global Partners operated privately in its early years before raising $2.7 million in an angel round in 2025. This investment came from family, friends, and ultra-high-net-worth individuals, enabling the company to expand its digital presence and accelerate international growth.
